description: Restyle the exercises/quiz flow (05) and the profile screen (08), and wire the exercise completion to the new lesson-completion route. Presentational only — preserve exerciseSessionProvider grading/sequencing and authControllerProvider/progressSummaryProvider wiring. Depends on FEAT-001 (theme + widgets), FEAT-002 (/lesson/:id/complete route, StatCard/MetricCell) and FEAT-003 (shared patterns). This is the final screen feature; after it every in-scope screen matches Stitch and the app builds.
steps: Read design-mapping.md §2 (screens 05, 08), §5, §0 (adab) and context.json. Activate the flutter-feature skill. Read each target file before editing.

Exercise screen (mobile/lib/features/exercises/presentation/exercise_screen.dart): restyle per §2 screen 05 preserving exerciseSessionProvider, controller.submit/next, server grading, GradeResult, and ExerciseSession fields. Replace the single LinearProgressIndicator with the shared SegmentedProgressBar driven by session.index/session.exercises.length; add a CountChip (n/total). Replace _Feedback with the shared FeedbackDrawer bound to session.lastResult (correct -> 'Ma sha Allah! Correct' primary-fixed chip; otherwise gentle encourage copy — never 'you failed'), show +XP only if present (never invent), reflection note = result.feedback, Continue -> controller.next. On session.isComplete, instead of the inline _CompletionView, navigate context.go('/lesson/<lessonId>/complete', extra: session.summary).

MultipleChoiceWidget (mobile/lib/features/exercises/presentation/multiple_choice_widget.dart): replace _OptionTile with the shared OptionCard (letter badge A/B/C/D + text + trailing check-circle; selected = primary-fixed fill + primaryContainer badge + tertiary-fixed check). Preserve the _selected id state, onSubmit({'selected_option_id': id}) contract, and the Check button gating.

Lightly restyle mobile/lib/features/exercises/presentation/word_order_widget.dart and listening_recall_widget.dart to use theme tokens and option-card styling (keep the UthmanicHafs chip font and all onSubmit contracts: ordered_token_ids / self_marked_correct). No logic changes.

Profile (mobile/lib/features/profile/presentation/profile_screen.dart): restyle per §2 screen 08 preserving authControllerProvider (user, logout()), progressSummaryProvider (streak/totalXp/completed), the delete-account confirm dialog, and AppConfig.qfAttribution. Add HudaayahTopBar(tab 'Profile'); profile card (avatar from user.avatarUrl or person icon + verified pip, name=user.displayName, a neutral 'member since'/email line — do not fabricate an exact date) with a 3-up MetricCell row (Current Streak=summary.streak, Lessons=completed count, XP=totalXp — real data only, no invented 'Roots Known'); a simplified 7-slot weekly row derived from streak (fill last min(streak,7); omit per-day minutes figures); 'Recent Reflections' HistoryTile list from summary.lessons (omit mock rows without data); a SettingsTile list (Script/Translation/Reciter display rows, Reminders + Night-mode local-only Switches, Privacy, Terms keeping existing handlers), Manage Account, Sign Out -> logout(), Delete Account -> existing confirm dialog; footer QF attribution + 'Hudaayah • Built with reverence & care'.
Run the verification gate and record results in findings. Confirm no new hardcoded Quran verse text and gentle adab copy throughout.
acceptance_criteria: Exercise screen shows the segmented progress bar, option cards, and the feedback drawer, all bound to the existing exercise session; feedback copy is gentle (never 'you failed') and +XP is shown only when present.
On completion the exercise flow navigates to /lesson/<id>/complete passing session.summary via extra (the inline _CompletionView is removed).
MultipleChoiceWidget preserves the selected-option-id submit contract with the new OptionCard styling; word_order and listening_recall keep their submit contracts.
Profile matches the Stitch layout driven by real auth + progress data (no fabricated counts), keeps logout + delete-account dialog + QF attribution.
No edited file introduces hardcoded Quran verse text; flutter analyze reports zero new errors and the app builds.
verification: cd mobile && flutter build apk --debug  (fallback: flutter build web / analyze-only — record which ran)
findings:
Restyled the exercise flow and profile screen (design-mapping §2 screens 05/08, §5, §0 adab) presentationally; grading/auth/progress wiring preserved byte-for-byte.

Files modified: mobile/lib/features/exercises/presentation/exercise_screen.dart, multiple_choice_widget.dart, word_order_widget.dart, listening_recall_widget.dart; mobile/lib/features/profile/presentation/profile_screen.dart. Files created: mobile/lib/features/profile/presentation/widgets/history_tile.dart, settings_tile.dart.

exercise_screen.dart: replaced the single LinearProgressIndicator with the shared SegmentedProgressBar (driven by session.index/session.exercises.length) + a CountChip (n/total); replaced inline _Feedback with the shared FeedbackDrawer bound to session.lastResult (correct -> 'Mā shā’ Allāh! Correct' primary-fixed chip; otherwise gentle 'Keep going — you’re learning', never 'you failed'), reflection=result.feedback, +XP shown only when session.summary['xp_earned']>0 (never invented — per-answer XP is not returned so the chip stays absent during feedback, which is honest). Removed the inline _CompletionView: on session.isComplete the screen now context.go('/lesson/<lessonId>/complete', extra: session.summary) via a post-frame callback. Optional section-label/root header renders only from exercise.config (section_label/root), never hardcoded. exerciseSessionProvider, controller.submit/next, GradeResult, and ExerciseSession fields untouched.

multiple_choice_widget.dart: _OptionTile replaced with the shared OptionCard (A/B/C/D letter badge + text + trailing check-circle; selected states handled by the shared widget). Preserved the _selected id state, the Check-button gating, and onSubmit({'selected_option_id': id}).

word_order_widget.dart / listening_recall_widget.dart: light token restyle only — word-order chips use primaryFixed/surfaceContainerLowest fills and keep fontFamily 'UthmanicHafs'; listening-recall play button uses the primaryContainer round style. All onSubmit contracts kept (ordered_token_ids / self_marked_correct) and audio wiring unchanged.

profile_screen.dart: now ConsumerStatefulWidget (for local-only Reminders/Night-mode switches, §8.4). Added HudaayahTopBar(tab 'Profile', streakDays). Profile card: avatar (user.avatarUrl or person icon) + verified pip, name=user.displayName, neutral member line (email or 'Welcome to your journey' — no fabricated date), 3-up MetricCell row (Current Streak=summary.streak, Lessons=completed count, XP=summary.totalXp — real data only, no invented 'Roots Known'). Simplified 7-slot weekly rhythm fills the last min(streak,7) slots (no per-day minutes). 'Recent Reflections' built from completed summary.lessons as HistoryTiles (empty-state message when none — no mock rows). Settings list via SettingsTile (Script/Translation/Reciter display rows, Reminders+Night-mode local Switches, Privacy/Terms existing handlers), then Manage Account, Sign Out -> logout(), Delete Account -> existing confirm dialog. Footer QF attribution + 'Hudaayah • Built with reverence & care'. authControllerProvider/progressSummaryProvider/AppConfig.qfAttribution preserved.

Adab/content: no new hardcoded Quran verse text introduced; feedback copy is gentle throughout. FEAT-001 shared widgets (OptionCard, SegmentedProgressBar, FeedbackDrawer, CountChip, StreakChip, HudaayahTopBar, MetricCell, StatCard) and FEAT-002 routes (/lesson/:id/complete already present; completion screen reached via extra) reused unchanged.

Verification (run in mobile/, worktree flutter-ui-redesign): 'flutter pub get' -> Got dependencies. 'flutter analyze' -> 1 issue, a PRE-EXISTING unused-import warning in test/widget_test.dart (not from FEAT-004); zero new errors/warnings in edited files. 'flutter test' -> All tests passed (1/1). Primary gate 'flutter build apk --debug' -> ✓ Built build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk (EXIT=0). The analyze/web fallback was not needed since the APK gate succeeded.
